# Zoftcorp

> Enterprise Technology & Database Advisory

Zoftcorp delivers enterprise-grade cloud architecture, high-availability database performance tuning, statutory compliance (DPDP, SOC2), and specialized database management advisory with boutique agility.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- [Cloud & Data FinOps](https://zoftcorp.com/consulting/cloud-finops): Deliver 20–30% measurable reduction in cloud compute, storage, and database licensing spend.
- [Performance Tuning Delivery](https://zoftcorp.com/offerings/performance-tuning-delivery): High-concurrency database engine optimization, query execution plan tuning, index matrix design, and latency minimization.
- [Managed DBA Services](https://zoftcorp.com/offerings/managed-dba-services): Proactive 24/7 database operations, telemetry, SLA-backed maintenance, and disaster recovery.
- [Database Migrations & Transformations](https://zoftcorp.com/offerings/database-migrations-and-transformations): Zero-downtime cross-platform migrations across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, and Oracle.
- [Data Engineering & Analytics](https://zoftcorp.com/offerings/data-engineering-and-analytics): Scalable ETL/ELT pipelines, real-time analytics, and data lakehouse architecture.
- [Resilience and Continuity](https://zoftcorp.com/consulting/resilience-compliance): High-availability architectures, zero-data-loss failover protocols, and disaster recovery validation.
- [DPDP Compliance & Governance](https://zoftcorp.com/consulting/compliance-governance): Statutory DPDP Act compliance assessment, data flow governance, and readiness roadmap.

## Technology Ecosystems

- [Partnerships Overview](https://zoftcorp.com/about-us/partnerships): Enterprise cloud and database alliance portfolio.
- [AWS Technology Ecosystem](https://zoftcorp.com/about-us/partnerships/aws): Amazon Aurora, RDS (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server), DynamoDB, Redshift.
- [Microsoft Azure Ecosystem](https://zoftcorp.com/about-us/partnerships/azure): Azure SQL Database, Managed Instances, Cosmos DB, Synapse Analytics.
- [Google Cloud Ecosystem](https://zoftcorp.com/about-us/partnerships/gcp): Cloud SQL, AlloyDB, Spanner, BigQuery.
- [Oracle Technology Ecosystem](https://zoftcorp.com/about-us/partnerships/oracle): Oracle Database EE/SE, Exadata Cloud Service, Autonomous Database, RAC.
